headline: Borsa Istanbul General Manager Detained in Turkish Fund Investigation
summary: Turkish authorities detained Borsa Istanbul general manager Korkmaz Enes Ergün on October 31 in connection with an investigation into investment funds, according to Anadolu Agency.
why: Borsa Istanbul is Turkey's sole stock exchange, operating equities, debt securities, and derivatives markets. Legal and regulatory actions involving exchange leadership can impact market governance and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Borsa Istanbul
impacts.why: The detention of the exchange's general manager introduces governance uncertainty across domestic market operations.
